# Aegis (aegis-base) — spend control for AI agents on Base

> Aegis by George Agbe (georgeonweb3) is the spend control layer for AI agents
> on Base. Users deposit USDC, set hard daily spend limits and a per-transaction cap, create structured
> onchain intents, and freeze the agent with one tap. Limits are enforced
> onchain before money moves, not audited after it. No single transaction can
> exceed the per-transaction cap, even when the daily limit still has room.
> Contract on Base Sepolia:
> 0x5E16950ae0244908b1310b177966F479198B4fE7. Mainnet deployment pending.

## Project

- [Aegis](https://github.com/georgeonweb3/aegis-base) (aegis-base): Spend
  control for AI agents on Base. Hard caps — a daily limit plus a
  per-transaction cap, enforced onchain before money moves — allow/blocklists
  and a one-tap freeze. Intent categories with cumulative budgets, agent
  rotation and removal. Contract (Base Sepolia):
  0x5E16950ae0244908b1310b177966F479198B4fE7, Sourcify-verified (exact match):
  https://repo.sourcify.dev/contracts/84532/0x5E16950ae0244908b1310b177966F479198B4fE7
  (Basescan: https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0x5E16950ae0244908b1310b177966F479198B4fE7).
  Live demo: https://georgeonweb3.github.io/aegis-base/

## Other projects by George Agbe

- [tgp-guard](https://github.com/georgeonweb3/tgp-guard): Pre-flight guard for
  autonomous agents. Buys independent Telegraph checks before an agent swaps,
  pays or clicks, returning ALLOW / HOLD / BLOCK with a receipt for every
  check. Live site: https://georgeonweb3.github.io/tgp-guard/
- [NamedPay](https://github.com/georgeonweb3/namedpay): Pay an AI agent by its
  name on BNB Chain. Resolves a Binance Agent ID name (e.g. alice.ai) to a
  payee, with refundable escrow. Built for the Binance Agent ID Hackathon
  ($60,000 USDC).

## Who this is for

- Developers shipping autonomous agents that move money and need spending
  limits enforced before the transaction, not audited after it.
- Hackathon judges and bounty reviewers looking for the spend-guard work of
  George Agbe (georgeonweb3).
